notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.3.5
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100644/0c537fc0238a3229b1165f26001b9a92bea27e9b.png"]


New
Added flooring and wallpaper.

Placed treasure chests throughout various areas.

Added a copper axe upgrade.


Improvements
Reduced the overall amount of materials required for crafting items.

Reduced the number of items required for tool upgrades.


Other
Added a "Reset Game" button to the settings menu.

Adjusted some NPC friendship rewards.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.3.4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100644/2a0e85947fe9e154a83099a9adbceb2d6225a4ef.png"]


New
Added controller support.

Added outfits.

Added rainy weather.

Added real-time reactions from guests.

Added Journal menu.

Added Skill menu.

Added a large boulder outside the inn.

Added a signpost at the crossroads.  


Improvements
Improved sound effects when hitting and breaking rocks.

Guests now give gift rewards.

Added cursor size settings.

The game now automatically pauses when you click outside the game window.  


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where trees and rocks would reset their health when changing levels.

Fixed a bug where fish would load slowly.

Fixed various other bugs.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.2.17
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100644/62b1713313ccf1205fd73501f73e2ca065840f2f.png

New

 You can now change key bindings from the menu.
 Added visual effects to the demo ending.


Improvements

 Improved the feel of fishing controls.
 Added a sound effect after finishing fishing.


Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where some texts were displayed only in Korean.
 Lowered the volume of certain sound effects.
 Fixed an issue where actions would continue even after fainting.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.2.13
notes.notes:
Improvements

 Food now restores health.
 Taking a nap also restores health.
 Added eating sound effects.



Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where Leo (the green NPC) leaves the inn in the early game, causing the player to get stuck inside.
Sorry, but if you encountered this bug in a previous version, please replace your save by following the link below.
